children: RNS Number : 4229W  Wickes Group PLC  25 September 2026

In accordance with Listing Rule 6.4.6R(3), Wickes Group Plc announces that Octavia Morley, a current Independent Non-executive Director of the Company, will replace Mark Clare as Chair of the Company’s Remuneration Committee with effect from 1 October 2026. Mark Clare will remain a member of the Committee.
